description.value:
Blaster's dreamstuff hardens as his body breaks. He gains resistance to all damage based on his current Hit Points.

  • 75% HP or lower Resistance 10 (525 HP at maximum 700).
  • 50% HP or lower Resistance 15 (350 HP).
  • 25% HP or lower Resistance 20 (175 HP).

Only the highest applicable resistance applies. Healing above a threshold lowers the resistance accordingly; temporary HP don't count toward these thresholds.

When using Charged Blast, Grand Finale, or a Beam Clash counter-hit, Blaster chooses one mode. Rider modes roll 3 fewer damage dice. Apply riders after damage, using the final save outcome.

  • Raw Fire, cold, electricity, or sonic; DC 40 basic Reflex.
  • Dazzling Light Fire and light; DC 40 basic Reflex. Failure or critical failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterDazzle001]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
  • Psychic Humiliation Mental; DC 40 basic Will. Failure or critical failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterStupor001]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.
  • Slowing Beam Cold; DC 40 basic Fortitude. Success: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterSlow00001]{Slowed 1}; failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterSlow00002]{Slowed 2}; critical failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterSlow00003]{Slowed 3}. Duration 1 round.
  • Hypno-Beam Mental, visual, incapacitation; DC 40 basic Will. Success: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterFascin001]{Fascinated} for 1 round; failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterControl01]{Controlled} for 1 round; critical failure: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterControl02]{permanently Controlled} until removed. A higher-level creature improves its save outcome by one degree.

Critical success has no rider. Fascinated ends normally if broken by hostility. Control cannot compel obviously self-destructive orders.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterResolve01]{Apply Blast Effect} uses the final outcome, after incapacitation.

Frequency once per round, shared by all Charged Blast variants

Area 120-foot line, 1 square wide (5 feet on a 5-foot grid)

Effect Blaster fires a straight 120-foot beam from his space. Choose one mode; roll damage once. Each creature other than Blaster attempts one save. Resolve line of effect normally and riders as listed in Curated Spectrum.

  • Fire @Damage[10d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire].
  • Cold @Damage[10d10[cold]|traits:magical,cold|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,cold].
  • Electricity @Damage[10d10[electricity]|traits:magical,electricity|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,electricity].
  • Sonic @Damage[10d10[sonic]|traits:magical,sonic|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,sonic].
  • Dazzling Light @Damage[7d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire,light|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire,light].
  • Psychic Humiliation @Damage[7d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental].
  • Slowing Beam @Damage[7d10[cold]|traits:magical,cold|options:area-damage]; @Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,cold].
  • Hypno-Beam @Damage[7d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation].

Area 120-foot line, 3 squares wide (15 feet on a 5-foot grid)

Effect Blaster fires a straight 120-foot beam from his space. Choose one mode; roll damage once. Each creature other than Blaster attempts one save. Resolve line of effect normally and riders as listed in Curated Spectrum.

  • Fire @Damage[27d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire].
  • Cold @Damage[27d10[cold]|traits:magical,cold|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,cold].
  • Electricity @Damage[27d10[electricity]|traits:magical,electricity|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,electricity].
  • Sonic @Damage[27d10[sonic]|traits:magical,sonic|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,sonic].
  • Dazzling Light @Damage[24d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire,light|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire,light].
  • Psychic Humiliation @Damage[24d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental].

  • Hypno-Beam @Damage[24d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation].

Blaster can't voluntarily move until the start of his next turn; forced movement is unaffected. After firing, wait [[/gmr 1d4 #Standing Ovation recharge]]{1d4} full intervening rounds before using Standing Ovation again. His one- and two-action blasts remain available.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterBlast0003]{Place Blast (3 Actions)} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterResolve01]{Apply Blast Effect} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterClear0001]{Clear Blast}. Movement costs and recharge are GM-adjudicated; the macro never locks movement.

Frequency once per round

Trigger A round begins.

Area seven connected line segments, each up to 120 feet long and 3 squares wide

Effect Blaster marks eight points, beginning in his space, and chooses one mode. The visible path deals no damage yet. At the start of the next round, he blasts the path without spending another action. The path stays fixed even if Blaster moves.

Each creature other than Blaster attempts one save and takes damage only once, even where segments overlap. Roll damage once. Resolve line of effect normally and riders as listed in Curated Spectrum.

  • Fire @Damage[36d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire].
  • Cold @Damage[36d10[cold]|traits:magical,cold|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,cold].
  • Electricity @Damage[36d10[electricity]|traits:magical,electricity|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,electricity].
  • Sonic @Damage[36d10[sonic]|traits:magical,sonic|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,sonic].
  • Dazzling Light @Damage[33d10[fire]|traits:magical,fire,light|options:area-damage]; @Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,fire,light].
  • Psychic Humiliation @Damage[33d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental].
  • Slowing Beam @Damage[33d10[cold]|traits:magical,cold|options:area-damage]; @Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,cold].
  • Hypno-Beam @Damage[33d10[mental]|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation|options:area-damage]; @Check[will|dc:40|basic|traits:magical,mental,visual,incapacitation].

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMark00001]{Mark Path} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterFire00001]{Fire Now} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterResolve01]{Apply Blast Effect} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterWipe00001]{Clear Finale}

Frequency once per round

Requirements An unoccupied space within 30 feet and line of effect.

Effect Blaster summons one support thrall with 1 HP and a 1-minute lifetime. Its signature aura is active immediately:

  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-actors.Actor.BlasterThrall001]{Hype Fan}: Inspire.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-actors.Actor.BlasterThrall002]{Ego Guard}: Guard.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-actors.Actor.BlasterThrall003]{Paparazzo}: Bolster.

Thralls have no independent turns or attacks. Different thralls' support stacks; there is no living-thrall cap. Command Flash Mob changes one thrall's mode.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterFlash0001]{Summon Thrall}

Requirements One of Blaster's living Flash Mob thralls is within 60 feet.

Effect Change one chosen thrall's support mode for its remaining lifetime. Replace that thrall's current aura with one of the following 60-foot auras, benefiting only its summoning Blaster. Other thralls keep their current modes.

  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraIns01]{Inspire} +1 untyped bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear while inside the aura.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard} +1 untyped bonus to AC while inside the aura.
  • @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster} Add 10 temporary HP to the Flash Mob pool once during this thrall's lifetime. Only Bolster auras currently covering Blaster contribute to his pool. Leaving or changing modes suspends that source's remaining HP; re-entry restores only unspent HP, never damage already absorbed. Higher unrelated temporary HP retain their source and duration.

Bonuses and temporary HP contributions from distinct thralls stack. A thrall supplies only one mode and never duplicates its own benefit. Its destruction, removal, or expiration ends its support.

The thrall gains no movement or other actions. Command Flash Mob has no frequency or combat requirement.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Thrall}

Frequency once per round

Trigger A visible foe targets Blaster with a line or beam effect, before it resolves.

Effect Suspend the triggering effect and start a clash at 0. Blaster and the foe each roll an unmodified d20. The higher roll shifts the score 1 point toward its roller (+1 for Blaster, -1 for the foe); ties leave it unchanged. Repeat until the score reaches +3 or -3.

These dice are not checks: modifiers, fortune, misfortune, and natural 1/20 special results do not apply.

Blaster Wins (+3) Negate the triggering effect against Blaster only. Then resolve one normal hit on the targeted foe using Blaster's two-action Curated Spectrum blast damage (raw 14d8, rider 11d8) with no additional attack roll or saving throw. Use rider failure outcomes. If the foe is higher level than Blaster and the rider is Hypno-Beam, improve that rider result by one degree of success before applying effects.

Foe Wins (-3) The incoming effect automatically resolves against Blaster as a critical hit or as a critically failed save, whichever applies to that effect.

Other targets resolve normally. The clash grants no additional actions or reactions and does not transfer ownership or permissions.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterClash0001]{Start Clash} - @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterStop00001]{End Clash} - [[/r 1d20 #Beam Clash manual contest]]{Manual d20 (no tracker)}

Frequency once per day

Area 100-foot radius centered on Blaster at release

Effect Blaster takes damage normally until the start of his next turn, banking post-resistance damage, including damage absorbed by temporary HP. He then explodes, dealing force damage equal to the bank to each other creature in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|immutable|traits:magical,force] save). Blaster is excluded.

This is flat damage, not extra dice or multiplied damage. Outside combat, release occurs after 6 world-time seconds.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterBack00001]{Arm / Edit Bank} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterBackFire1]{Fire Now} · @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterBackClear]{Clear}. The GM can adjust the bank or fire at any time.
Blaster fires a crystal projectile that deals @Damage[(3d10+17)[piercing]] damage on a hit. This Strike is not a Charged Blast.
Blaster lashes out with a contemptuous backhand, dealing @Damage[(3d8+17)[bludgeoning]] damage on a hit. This Strike is not a Charged Blast.

You gradually merge several kinds of energy into your cupped hands before firing off a storm of bolts and beams that deal 4d4 force damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line. Creatures in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save. On a critical failure, they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2] for 1 round. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines the area. If the line passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, inner radiance torrent attempts to counteract the darkness.

2 The line is 60 feet long.

3 The line is 120 feet long.

Two Rounds If you spend 3 actions casting the spell, you can avoid finishing the spell and spend another 2 actions on your next turn to empower the spell even further. You can take other actions before finishing this spell, but the spell is lost if you Cast another Spell in between. The line is 120 feet long, the damage dealt by this spell increases by 4d4, and you enter a shining state for 1 minute, causing you to glow with light and deal @Damage[(max(2,@item.rank)-1)[force]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures that end their turn adjacent to you.

Heightened (+1) The initial damage, as well as the additional damage for the 2-round casting time, each increase by 2d4, and the damage to adjacent creatures dealt while in your shining state increases by 1.

You send out a ray of colored light streaming toward your enemy, with a magical effect depending on the ray's color. Make a spell attack roll. If you hit, roll [[/r 1d4]]{1d4} to see which beam you cast. If the ray deals damage, that damage is doubled on a critical hit. Any additional traits that apply to a ray are listed in parentheses just after the name of the color.

  1. Red (fire) The ray deals @Damage[30[fire]] damage to the target.
  2. Orange (acid) The ray deals @Damage[40[acid]] damage to the target.
  3. Yellow (electricity) The ray deals @Damage[50[electricity]] damage to the target.
  4. Green (poison) The ray deals @Damage[25[poison]] damage to the target, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).

Heightened (6th) The damage for @Damage[40[fire]]{Red}, @Damage[50[acid]]{Orange}, @Damage[60[electricity]]{Yellow}, and @Damage[35[poison]]{Green} each increase by 10. Roll [[/r 1d8]]{1d8} to determine the ray's color, using the results for 1-4 above and the results for 5-8 below.

  1. Blue The ray has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA] spell. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} as long as it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3] by the flesh to stone effect.
  2. Indigo (emotion, incapacitation, mental) The ray has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY] spell. On a critical hit, it has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs] instead.
  3. Violet The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3] for 1 minute. It must also succeed at a will save or be teleported 120 feet directly away from you (if there isn't room for it to appear there, it appears in the nearest open space); this is a teleportation effect.
  4. Intense Color The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh] until the end of your next turn, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2] if your attack roll was a critical hit. Roll again and add the effects of another color (rerolling results of 8).

You create a cloud of mesmerizing patterns and colors that hovers in the air. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh] while inside the cloud. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the cloud when you cast it, when it enters the cloud, when it ends its turn within the cloud, or if it uses a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ] or Interact action on the cloud. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg] by hypnotize doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud.

Critical Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud. While it remains fascinated, it can't use reactions.

Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.0PO5mFRhh9HxGAtv]

You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE] use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]

Requirements At least one of Blaster's living Flash Mob thralls is within 60 feet and line of effect.

Effect Blaster drinks in his audience's adoration until nothing remains of them. Destroy one, two, or three chosen thralls. Blaster regains 40 HP per thrall destroyed, up to 120 HP. Their support ends normally.

  • One thrall @Damage[40[healing]]
  • Two thralls @Damage[80[healing]]
  • Three thralls @Damage[120[healing]]

Choose one healing amount. Remove the chosen thralls and apply healing to Blaster; the GM adjudicates this action.

Blaster is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened}. He can use the extra action only to Strike or Stride. When he Strides with it, he must use Recoil Stride: the movement propels him forward by blasting behind him.

Other quickened sources don't grant additional actions. Normal slowed and stunned rules still apply.

Requirements Blaster uses the extra action from Self-Propelled Superstar to Stride.

Effect Blaster Strides and fires a 15-foot line, 1 square wide, from his departure point in the opposite direction. Choose one Curated Spectrum mode. This deals Snapshot damage (10d10 raw or 7d10 with a rider), with its DC 40 basic save and rider. Blaster is excluded.

This blast is part of the quickened Stride: no extra action, Charged Blast frequency, or recharge is spent.

Foundry @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterRecoil001]{Arm Recoil Stride}, choose a mode, then drag Blaster normally. Escape cancels the pending blast.

Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature succeeds at Demoralize or Bon Mot against Blaster, or publicly humiliates him in a way the GM deems convincing.

Effect Blaster's dreamstuff fractures under the insult. He takes @Damage[30[mental]|immutable] damage, ignoring Dreamshell, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. Resolve the triggering action's normal effects as well.

Exposing his lies to his audience, turning his fans against him, or publicly besting his showmanship can qualify. Generic insults alone don't guarantee a trigger; the GM decides.

Foundry Apply the damage manually without Dreamshell, then drag @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterEgoHurt01]{Bruised Ego} onto Blaster.

details.blurb: A theatrical artillery villain who needs every battle to applaud him.
details.publicNotes: Blaster announces every attack as his definitive masterpiece. He craves adulation, treats followers as disposable props, and manipulates rivals into playing to his audience. His grandiosity conceals a fragile ego: defiance and public embarrassment provoke ostentatious retaliation.
details.privateNotes:
Foundry Operating Notes

Use Foundry V14, PF2e, and the active GM client. All Blaster action macros are usable at any time, with or without combat. They do not enforce turns, once-per-round limits, or recharge. Adjudicate the listed action costs, frequencies, and recharge. No macro writes or enforces a movement lock. Placement and ownership ranges still apply; moving while aiming cancels only that unfinished placement.

Updating an Existing Blaster

Blastback is once per day, tracked with its native sheet frequency; GM override macros are not locked. Arm normally, then take damage normally. The bank follows native PF2e damageTaken after immunities, weaknesses, and resistances, including temporary-HP damage. Riders and Beam Clash

Apply Blast Effect expects the final outcome after incapacitation. Higher-level targets improve a Hypno-Beam save by one degree. Remove the Fascinated effect manually when hostility breaks it. Controlled means the GM directs actions, not ownership changes; do not issue obviously self-destructive orders. Permanent control lasts until removed, counteracted, or ended by the GM.

Beam Clash costs a reaction. A loss automatically accepts an incoming critical hit or critically failed save. A win negates the incoming effect against Blaster only and allows one free out-of-turn, normal two-action-strength counterhit against the foe, no attack or save. Its rider uses failure, or success for Hypno-Beam against a higher-level foe. This adjustment is already shown on the card. The manual d20 link does not submit to the tracker. End cancels an active contest without a winner or refunding its cost. Clash rolls/start/end create no chat messages; resolving the counterblast explicitly creates one damage card.

Flash Mob Auras

PF2e Summons Assistant is required. Flash Mob places one chosen add within 30 feet; there is no living-thrall cap. Every add starts with its signature aura: Hype Fan @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraIns01]{Inspire}, Ego Guard @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraGrd01]{Guard}, Paparazzo @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterAuraBol01]{Bolster}. All three variants can Inspire, Guard, or Bolster. Command changes one thrall's mode for its remaining lifetime; it does not reset expiration or affect other thralls.

Native 60-foot auras affect only the summoning Blaster, regardless of token disposition, never allies or the emitting thrall. Inspire and Guard apply while inside the native aura; distinct thralls stack untyped bonuses with unique source slugs. Automatic auras require no embedded receiver items; Aura Totals supplies their summed bonuses. The support pack's effects and auras can be dragged onto any actor by the GM. Manual auras affect their bearer and allies; manual effects activate directly and are not removed by the module's summon cleanup. Directly dropped Bolster effects use native temporary-HP rules; all Flash Mob Bolster auras use cumulative source balances.

Bolster adds 10 temporary HP once per thrall lifetime. Distinct contributions add together and spend FIFO. Spent HP never refill on re-entry, mode changes, revival, or link repair. Unspent balances are suspended outside their Bolster aura or while the add uses another mode; re-entry restores only the remainder. Death/removal/expiry ends the contribution. The pool uses the maximum against unrelated temporary HP; damage spends both visible and retained pools to prevent hidden regeneration. Native temporary HP are capped at 999.

Use unlinked NPC tokens when there are multiple Blasters. Native summoner signature and module owner linkage identify the correct owner. Existing pre-update thralls should be replaced through Flash Mob; world actors are not overwritten by a module update.
